name: MessageByChat
doc: A single chat message; mirrors the CQL messages_by_chat table. Date and hour are carried as a single timestamp-millis field (sent_at); the writer derives msg_date and msg_hour from it when binding to Cassandra.

fields.name: chat_id
fields.doc: Chat the message belongs to (part of the CQL partition key)

fields.name: sent_at
fields.doc: When the message was sent (UTC epoch millis). Source of truth for msg_date (UTC day) and msg_hour (UTC hour 0-23) in the CQL table, and the final clustering column that identifies the row
